description: List the PDB structures that contain a UniProt protein or match an InterPro or member-database entry, a page at a time in PDB ID order. Filter either target by experimentType and maxResolution; a resolution bound excludes nulls, as for NMR and some EM structures. Optionally filter an entry target by taxonId. Set exactly one of proteinAccession or entryAccession. Each structure's chain records follow in chains, joined by pdbId: for a protein, chain positions mapped to UniProt positions; for an entry, its match locations in chain numbering beside author auth_start/auth_end and in UniProt numbering, with protein null on unmapped chains. InterPro nests at most 20 chain records per structure, flagged by chainRecordLimitReached. A row's metadata.accession and a record's chain feed interpro_get_structure_domains as pdbId and chain. Continue page.nextCursor until hasMore is false.

cursor.description: Opaque page.nextCursor with the same target and filters; limit may change.

limit.description: Positive integer page size in structures; values above 50 are clamped to 50 with a notice; defaults to 20. Entry-target rows carry each chain’s sequence, so their pages can run to hundreds of kilobytes.

maxResolution.description: Inclusive upper resolution bound in ångströms. Excludes null resolutions.

proteinAccession.description: Canonical UniProt accession, such as P04637, whose PDB structures to list; set this or entryAccession, never both.

sourceDatabase.description: Database slug for entryAccession, inferred from standard accession prefixes when omitted; not used with proteinAccession.

taxonId.description: Positive NCBI taxonomy identifier of at most 10 digits, for entry targets only.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_target`: The call sets neither or both of proteinAccession and entryAccession, or sourceDatabase or taxonId beside proteinAccession. `protein_not_found`: The first page is empty and the canonical protein detail returns HTTP 204 or 404. `entry_not_found`: The accession is a set accession, InterPro rejects it for its database with HTTP 404, or the first page is empty and the entry detail returns HTTP 204 or 404. `entry_withdrawn`: InterPro reports the protein, the entry, or its structure list withdrawn with HTTP 410. `database_mismatch`: Explicit sourceDatabase conflicts with entryAccession routing. `accession_source_unknown`: entryAccession matches no standard prefix and no sourceDatabase was supplied. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor decoding or scope fails, or upstream rejects continuation. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The shared fifty-second budget expires across the list page and the target detail. `upstream_shape_invalid`: Upstream JSON, structure, or continuation is incompatible. `upstream_response_too_large`: An upstream response exceeds 4 MiB. `upstream_rejected`: InterPro returns an unhandled redirect or client rejection. `upstream_unavailable`: InterPro has a network or server failure; HTTP 501 is not retryable. `upstream_timeout`: InterPro returns HTTP 408/504 or an attempt exceeds its deadline. `upstream_rate_limited`: InterPro returns HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
